2016 Chevrolet Silverado 1500 Performance and Engine

5.3L EcoTec3 V8 — Power When You Need It

The heart of this truck is Chevrolet's 5.3L EcoTec3 V8, producing 355 horsepower and 383 lb-ft of torque in its standard configuration. Paired with the 6-speed heavy-duty automatic transmission with overdrive, this powertrain delivers smooth, confident acceleration whether you're merging onto I-205 or towing a trailer through the Cascades. The EcoTec3 engine family introduced advanced features like Active Fuel Management — cylinder deactivation that cuts to four cylinders during light-load cruising to improve fuel economy — along with direct injection and variable valve timing. Z71 Off-Road Package and 4WD

Chevrolet Silverado 1500 Features and Interior

LT Trim Comfort and Technology

The Z71 off-road package adds Rancho monotube shock absorbers, underbody skid plates, all-terrain tires, and specific Z71 badging. It's Chevrolet's factory off-road upgrade and meaningfully improves the truck's capability on rough terrain compared to a standard 4WD Silverado.

Properly equipped, the 2016 Silverado 1500 with the 5.3L EcoTec3 V8 can tow up to approximately 11,500 pounds — among the highest in the half-ton truck segment for its model year. Actual tow ratings depend on specific rear axle ratio and configuration.
